sources.title: Ministry of Security: launch of the eVisaBurkina platform
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Security directly published this 2023 launch account. It authenticates the eVisaBurkina service historically, but does not state a current nationality schedule or controlling visitor-eligibility rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: tout étranger, assujetti au visa, qui souhaiterait se rendre au Burkina Faso, pourra formuler sa demande en ligne

sources.title: Service Public Burkina Faso: e-visa MSECU directory entry
sources.publisher: Service Public, Government of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government Service Public directory has a separate e-visa card assigned to MSECU. Its literal href is 'visaburkina.bf', without a scheme, so it is a malformed relative link and does not independently authenticate the canonical Visa Burkina URL; the live Embassy link does.

sources.title: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye: visa service
sources.publisher: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy page is on Burkina Faso's diplomatic-government domain. It directs short-stay applicants to Visa Burkina and describes an EVISA sent after acceptance, but names no passport nationality or exemption cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: En cas d’acceptation de sa demande, le demandeur recevra un message email contenant en pièce-jointe, un document « EVISA»

sources.title: Visa Burkina: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Burkina Faso Embassy page independently directs short-stay applicants to this exact Visa Burkina URL. The current portal footer identifies the Ministry of Security and Directorate General of the National Police; the Service Public directory separately lists the MSECU e-visa service but has a malformed relative href.
sources.supportingExcerpt: le visa électronique est envoyé, après approbation ministérielle, par e-mail au requérant

sources.title: Visa Burkina: entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: This entry-conditions page is part of the exact Visa Burkina service linked by the live Burkina Faso Embassy. Its current footer identifies the Ministry of Security and Directorate General of the National Police; the Service Public directory separately lists MSECU e-visa but has a malformed relative href.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Un visa d’entrée ou un accord de visa ou un permis ou titre de séjour sauf exemption

sources.title: Government Information Service: return of diplomatic and consular staff after Paris mission closure
sources.publisher: Government Information Service of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: This current Government Information Service publication dated 13 July 2026 reports the closure of Burkina Faso's Paris diplomatic representation and the return of embassy and consular staff. It prevents treating the still-live Paris website as current visa evidence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: après la fermeture de la représentation diplomatique du Burkina Faso en République française

sources.title: Government communiqué following United States visa restrictions
sources.publisher: Government Information Service of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government Information Service page on gouvernement.gov.bf embeds the Ministry of Foreign Affairs communiqué PDF dated 30 December 2025. It records a reciprocal-measures decision but does not publish its current operational implementation or ordinary-visitor terms.
sources.supportingExcerpt: appliquer aux ressortissants des États-Unis d’Amérique des mesures équivalentes en matière de visas

conflicts.explanation: The 30 December 2025 communiqué records Burkina Faso's decision to apply equivalent visa measures to United States nationals. It does not publish present implementation, an ordinary-passport short-visitor route, exceptions, duration, or issuance method. This is recorded narrowly as a material conflict against assuming the fallback eVisa path, not as proof of an implemented replacement status.
